title: Effects of stickiness in quantum chaotic billiards with $n$-fold symmetry
summary: In this work, we study a family of fully chaotic billiards that exhibits only rotational symmetries, whose geometry is based on the $C_3$ symmetry system proposed by Leyvraz, Schmit, and Seligman~(LSS) in 1996. Quantum spectral analyses are performed on billiards with symmetry $C_n$~(the billiard repeats itself under rotations of $2π/n$), where $n$ is the symmetry parameter. In these systems, there are subspaces of singlets~(invariant under time reversal) and doublets~(not invariant under time reversal).
